about_the_game:
The battlefield of the 1990s and early 2000s comes alive in a war where strategy meets direct control. Armored vehicles grind forward, infantry secure positions, and every decision you make shifts the balance of power.

You stand at the heart of it all — free to command the operation from above or take matters into your own hands. Issue orders, move formations, and oversee the flow of combat… or jump into the driver’s seat, man a turret, or step into the boots of a soldier. Switch instantly between the wide lens of a commander and the ground-level intensity of third-person and first-person control.

Tanks, armored personnel carriers, and support units all play their part. Positioning, timing, and coordination decide who holds the line and who is pushed back. Yet when the battle turns critical, sometimes it takes one well-placed shot — yours — to turn defeat into victory.

This is your war to shape. Plan it, command it, fight it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 64-bit Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel or AMD processor, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570 series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 /1164-bit Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 3.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600XT series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: Command modern warfare from every angle. Plan your strategy in top-down RTS view, take control of vehicles and units in third-person, or step inside the cockpit and fight in first-person. Experience the battlefields of the 1990s–2000s like never before.
